[[File:Neutral_Jedi_Zone_TEGTPM.jpg|250px|thumb|Neutral Jedi Zone on Barab I]]
The '''Neutral Jedi Zone''' was a large cave that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]. The Zone was used by the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as a planetary court, to solve disputes that could not be resolved at a local level. Various methods of arbitration were used in the court, including one-on-one combat, hunting contests, small battles and debates in which the participators made personal attacks on one another. The Zone also contained some luxury accommodation and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that visited Barab I were offered the use of the luxury facilities, in return for their assistance in resolving disputes between important individuals or Barabel clans.
